# Maher Electrical

> Maher Electrical is a registered electrical contractor (ECSSA) and SEAI-registered solar installer based in Mountmellick, Co. Laois, Ireland, run by Conn Maher. Services include domestic, commercial and industrial electrical work, solar PV and battery storage, EV charger installation, electrical inspections and emergency call-outs across Co. Laois, Co. Offaly, Co. Kildare and the Midlands.

## Services
- [House Rewiring & New Build Wiring](https://maherelectrical.ie/rewiring/): Full and partial rewires, first and second fix wiring for new builds, extensions and renovations.
- [Fuse Board & Consumer Unit Upgrades](https://maherelectrical.ie/fuse-board/): Modern RCBO/RCD protection, surge protection, testing and certification.
- [Solar PV Installation](https://maherelectrical.ie/solar-pv/): SEAI-registered solar panel installation with battery storage and monitoring for homes, farms and businesses; SEAI grant paperwork handled.
- [EV Charger Installation](https://maherelectrical.ie/ev-chargers/): Zappi 7kW home chargers with solar integration, plus commercial and fleet charge points.
- [Electrical Inspections & Certification](https://maherelectrical.ie/inspections/): Installation Condition Reports and certification for house sales, landlords and businesses.
- [Emergency Electrician](https://maherelectrical.ie/emergency-electrician/): Seven-day call-outs for tripping fuse boards, power loss, burning smells and electrical faults.

## Guides
- [SEAI Solar PV Grant Guide](https://maherelectrical.ie/guides/solar-grant/): Eligibility basics and how the application process works (updated 13 September 2026).
- [Home EV Charger Grant Guide](https://maherelectrical.ie/guides/ev-charger-grant/): Who qualifies, approved chargers and installers, and the steps from survey to sign-off (updated 13 September 2026).
- [What Affects Electrician Costs](https://maherelectrical.ie/guides/electrician-costs/): What drives electrical quotes in Ireland and how to compare them like-for-like (updated 13 September 2026).

## Service Areas
- [Co. Laois](https://maherelectrical.ie/areas/laois/): Mountmellick, Portlaoise, Portarlington, Mountrath, Abbeyleix — home county.
- [Co. Offaly](https://maherelectrical.ie/areas/offaly/): Tullamore, Edenderry, Birr.
- [Co. Kildare](https://maherelectrical.ie/areas/kildare/): Athy, Kildare Town, Monasterevin.
- [Carlow & Kilkenny](https://maherelectrical.ie/areas/carlow-kilkenny/): Carlow Town, Graiguecullen, north Kilkenny.

## Projects
- [Solar PV & Zappi EV Charger, Portlaoise](https://maherelectrical.ie/projects/solar-portlaoise.html): 10x 455W panels, 5kW inverter, 5kWh battery and Zappi 7kW charger on a new build.
